integrity.claim_consistency: Blockwise C2-indistinguishability plus sharp three-anchor rank-four Pasch separator.
integrity.verification_basis: Symbolic proof for all parameters; two executed exhaustive finite checkers for the fifteen-point examples.

scientific_limitations: Blockwise blindness is for nontrivial simple Steiner 2-designs and for marked points contained in one block; no assertion is made for other anchor configurations.
The order-fifteen sharp lower quantifier-rank statement concerns noncollinear three-point landmarks, not all Steiner designs.
The Bose-system anti-Pasch property is exhaustively verified for one finite explicit design; the all-parameter theorem is proved symbolically.
Specialized unindexed or inaccessible antecedents may exist; independent mathematical audit has not occurred.
title: Three-anchor Pasch detection and blockwise blindness in Steiner incidence graphs
